vibe_rationale: Authentic grassroots artist community at huge statewide scale, but diffuse and open-access rather than curated multi-format.
fit_notes: Broad, older-leaning arts audience across metro and regional SA with weak wellness adjacency. The venue-hosted model means a brand could host an exhibition in a cafe or winery, or back one of 13 awards, though the 1.76 million figure is 2022 attendances rather than visitors.
